name: Star Party
author: domiangeli
description: Fall to the ceiling between the structures as the wave at 45%. Move back into the level shortly before the dash orb at 46.0% and then fall back to the ceiling at 46.5% before the white decoration. Move back into the level at 47.0% shortly after the dual portal and then navigate through the gameplay as the wave until 48.5% where you can hold to the floor right after your icon passes the spike. Move back into the level at 51.2% between the spike and saw and spam in the middle of the level until 54% Navigate through the following gameplay as the wave until 57.3% where you have to fall into the top of the robot and mini portal to end up only hitting the mini portal and then ending up on the ceiling as the mini wave. Avoid the obstacles on the ceiling until 58.3% where you can move down, spam between the spikes and structure and then move back to the ceiling at 59%. Avoid the obstacles on the ceiling until 61.9% where you can hold to the floor between the spike and saw. Fall up between the saws at 71.6% to enter the cube portal and then start holding shortly after to be able to hold the dash orb. Release shortly before the green orb at 76% to fall to the floor between the white decoration and saw. Free to the end from there.
